tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search open remote jobs on Remotejobify by where the person lives. Each job comes with who can apply, the line from the listing that proves it, pay when listed, and a link. Pass country whenever you know where they live: most remote jobs are only open to some countries. Without it you get jobs open

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: One job on Remotejobify by its id or its remotejobify.app link: who can apply, the lines from the listing that prove it, pay, and the job description.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Remotejobify’s open remote jobs. Put the country the person lives in into the query ("customer support jobs in the Philippines"): most remote jobs are only open to some countries. Returns ids for fetch.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: One Remotejobify job by the id search gave: who can apply, the proof line and the description.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
